verses.sloka: राघवश्चापि विपुलं तं राक्षसवनौकसाम्।श्रुत्वा सङ्ग्रामनिर्घोषं जाम्बवन्तमुवाच ह ।। ६.८३.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāghavaścāpi vipulaṁ taṁ rākṣasavanaukasām।śrutvā saṅgrāmanirghoṣaṁ jāmbavantamuvāca ha ।। 6.83.1 ।।

translations.english: Hearing the great noise of war between Rakshasas and Vanaras, Rama said to Jambavantha.

verses.sloka: सौम्य नूनं हनुमता क्रियते कर्म दुष्करम्।श्रूयते हि यथा भीमः सुमहानायुधस्वनः ।। ६.८३.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: saumya nūnaṁ hanumatā kriyate karma duṣkaram।śrūyate hi yathā bhīmaḥ sumahānāyudhasvanaḥ ।। 6.83.2 ।।

translations.english: "O gentle Jambavan! The terrifying sound of weapons is heard. Surely Hanuman has done a difficult task."
translations.hindi: रावण क्रोध और शोक से व्याप्त हो ( अर्थात्‌ कद्ध और शोकान्वित हो ) बड़ी बड़ी आँखों बाले खर के पुत्र मकराक्ष से बोला

verses.sloka: तद्गच्छ कुरु साहाय्यं स्वबलेनाभिसंवृतः।क्षिप्रमृक्षपते तस्य कपिश्रेष्ठस्य युध्यतः ।। ६.८३.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadgaccha kuru sāhāyyaṁ svabalenābhisaṁvṛtaḥ।kṣipramṛkṣapate tasya kapiśreṣṭhasya yudhyataḥ ।। 6.83.3 ।।

translations.english: "O King of Bears! Accompanied by your army, go to the battlefield and help the best of monkeys."

verses.sloka: ऋक्षाराजस्तथोक्तस्तु स्वेनानीकेन संवृतः।आगच्छत् पश्चिमं द्वारं हनुमान् यत्र वानरः ।। ६.८३.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣārājastathoktastu svenānīkena saṁvṛtaḥ।āgacchat paścimaṁ dvāraṁ hanumān yatra vānaraḥ ।। 6.83.4 ।।

translations.english: Rama having spoken thus, King of Bears surrounded by Vanaras went to Hanuman at the western gate.
translations.hindi: रावण के ये वचन सुन शूर और अभिमानी खर के पुत्र मकराज्ञ राक्षस ने प्रसन्न हो कहा--“ बहुत अच्छा ”

verses.sloka: अथायान्तं हनूमन्तं ददर्शर्क्षपतिः पथि।वानरैः कृतसङ्ग्रामैः श्वसद्भिरभिसंवृतम् ।। ६.८३.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: athāyāntaṁ hanūmantaṁ dadarśarkṣapatiḥ pathi।vānaraiḥ kṛtasaṅgrāmaiḥ śvasadbhirabhisaṁvṛtam ।। 6.83.5 ।।

translations.english: Then the Lord of Bears saw Hanuman accompanied by Vanaras who fought in war coming sighing.

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा पथि हनूमांश्च तदृक्षबलमुद्यतम्।नीलमेघनिभं भीमं सन्निवार्य न्यवर्तत ।। ६.८३.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā pathi hanūmāṁśca tadṛkṣabalamudyatam।nīlameghanibhaṁ bhīmaṁ sannivārya nyavartata ।। 6.83.6 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman seeing the terrific army of Bears marching like a dark cloud asked them to return and he also returned with them.
translations.hindi: पास खड़े हुए अपने सेनाध्यत्ष से खर के पुत्र मकराष्न ने कहा-सेना को ओर मेरे रथ को ले आओ

verses.sloka: स तेन हरिसैन्येन सन्निकर्षं महायशाः।शीघ्रमागम्य रामाय दुःखितो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.८३.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tena harisainyena sannikarṣaṁ mahāyaśāḥ।śīghramāgamya rāmāya duḥkhito vākyamabravīt ।। 6.83.7 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman of great fame accompanied by army quickly came to Rama and submitted as follows.

verses.sloka: समरे युद्ध्यमानानामस्माकं प्रेक्षतां पुरः।जघान रुदतीं सीतामिन्द्रिजिद्रावणात्मजः ।। ६.८३.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: samare yuddhyamānānāmasmākaṁ prekṣatāṁ puraḥ।jaghāna rudatīṁ sītāmindrijidrāvaṇātmajaḥ ।। 6.83.8 ।।

translations.english: "Ravana's son, Indrajith struck Sita, who was crying in front of us looking at us while we were fighting in war."

verses.sloka: उद्भ्रान्तचित्तस्तां दृष्ट्वा विषण्णो ऽहमरिन्दम।तदहं भवतो वृत्तं विज्ञापयितुमागतः ।। ६.८३.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: udbhrāntacittastāṁ dṛṣṭvā viṣaṇṇo 'hamarindama।tadahaṁ bhavato vṛttaṁ vijñāpayitumāgataḥ ।। 6.83.9 ।।

translations.english: "O Tamer of enemies! Seeing her (Sita) bewildered in mind, worried, I have come to inform you accompanied by Vanaras."

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवः शोकमूर्च्छितः।निपपात तदा भूमौ छिन्नमूल इव द्रुमः ।। ६.८३.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rāghavaḥ śokamūrcchitaḥ।nipapāta tadā bhūmau chinnamūla iva drumaḥ ।। 6.83.10 ।।

translations.english: On hearing, Hanuman's words Raghava became deluded in sorrow and fell on the ground like a tree cut at the root.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि मुझे तो महाबलवान्‌ राक्षसराज रावण ने उन दोनों राजकुमार राम और लक्ष्मण से लड़ कर, उनका वघ करने की आज्ञा दी है

verses.sloka: तं भूमौ देवसङ्काशं पतितं प्रेक्ष्य राघवम्।अभिपेतुः समुत्पत्य सर्वतः कपिसत्तमाः ।। ६.८३.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ bhūmau devasaṅkāśaṁ patitaṁ prekṣya rāghavam।abhipetuḥ samutpatya sarvataḥ kapisattamāḥ ।। 6.83.11 ।।

translations.english: Seeing Raghava who is equal to god fallen on the ground, and the best of monkeys lifting him, the Vanaras from all over came jumping.

verses.sloka: असिञ्चन् सलिलैश्चैनं पद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिभिः।प्रदहन्तमनासाद्यं सहसा ऽग्निमिवोच्छिखम् ।। ६.८३.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: asiñcan salilaiścainaṁ padmotpalasugandhibhiḥ।pradahantamanāsādyaṁ sahasā 'gnimivocchikham ।। 6.83.12 ।।

translations.english: Reaching Rama, who was like a burning fire that has risen up and suddenly fallen, the Vanaras sprinkled water with fragrance of lotuses and lilies on Rama just as sprinkling water on an inextinguishable fire that has flared up suddenly.
translations.hindi: मैं आज उस बड़ी भारी वानरी सेना में पहुँच कर, उसे अपने सूल के प्रहार से उसी तरह जला कर भस्म कर डागा जिस तरह आग सूखे इंधन को जला कर राख कर डालती है

verses.sloka: तं लक्ष्मणो ऽथ बाहुभ्यां परिष्वज्य सुदुःखितः।उवाच राममस्वस्थं वाक्यं हेत्वर्थसंयुतम् ।। ६.८३.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ lakṣmaṇo 'tha bāhubhyāṁ pariṣvajya suduḥkhitaḥ।uvāca rāmamasvasthaṁ vākyaṁ hetvarthasaṁyutam ।। 6.83.13 ।।

translations.english: Then, Lakshmana who was very worried held the arms of Rama who was unwell and spoke these meaningful words.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे“ समागताः। . 5९५ __ युद्धकाण्डे सकराक्त के इन वचना को सुन, वे राक्षस लड़ने को तैयार हो गए। उनके हाथों में विविध प्रकार के आयुध थे और वे बड़े बलवान्‌ और सावधानता पूर्वक लड़ने वाले थे

verses.sloka: शुभे वर्त्मनि तिष्ठन्तं त्वामार्य विजितेन्द्रियम्।अनर्थेभ्यो न शक्नोति त्रातुं धर्मो निरर्थकः ।। ६.८३.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: śubhe vartmani tiṣṭhantaṁ tvāmārya vijitendriyam।anarthebhyo na śaknoti trātuṁ dharmo nirarthakaḥ ।। 6.83.14 ।।

translations.english: "O Noble Rama! If You, who have gained over senses and sticking to a virtuous path are not protected, from this calamity by righteousness, then righteousness is useless."
translations.hindi: वे सब के सब इच्छानुरूप अपने रूप बदलने वाले और बढे बड़े दांतों वाले थे। उनकी आँखें पीली पीली थीं । उनके सिरों पर बाल नथे। वे बड़े भयङ्कर थे ओर हाथी की तरह चिघाडते जाते थे

verses.sloka: भूतानां स्थावराणां च जङ्गमानां च दर्शनम्।यथा ऽस्ति न तथा धर्मस्तेन नास्तीति मे मतिः ।। ६.८३.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: bhūtānāṁ sthāvarāṇāṁ ca jaṅgamānāṁ ca darśanam।yathā 'sti na tathā dharmastena nāstīti me matiḥ ।। 6.83.15 ।।

translations.english: " As animate and inanimate beings are seen experiencing joy at present, righteousness is not the cause of joy, I think so."
translations.hindi: वे विशाल शरीरधारी प्रसन्न होते हुए, विशाल बपुधारी मकराक्ष को घेर कर और एथिवी कँपाते हुए चले

verses.sloka: यथैव स्थावरं व्यक्तं जङ्गमं च तथाविधम्।नायमर्थस्तथा युक्तस्त्वद्विधो न विपद्यते ।। ६.८३.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: yathaiva sthāvaraṁ vyaktaṁ jaṅgamaṁ ca tathāvidham।nāyamarthastathā yuktastvadvidho na vipadyate ।। 6.83.16 ।।

translations.english: "Just as inanimate beings which are seen happy and animate are also seen in the same manner, in which case that righteousness alone prospers is not there (for a person like you would not suffer). Knowing this you should not suffer."
translations.hindi: चारों ओर सहस्रं शङ्क ओर तुरही बज रही थीं। राक्षस सिंहनाद कर ताल ठोंक रहे थे । इन सब कारणों से उस समय . बडा कोलाहल हुआ

verses.sloka: यद्यधर्मो भवेद्भूतो रावणो नरकं व्रजेत्।भवांश्च धर्मयुक्तो वै नैवं व्यसनमाप्नुयात् ।। ६.८३.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: yadyadharmo bhavedbhūto rāvaṇo narakaṁ vrajet।bhavāṁśca dharmayukto vai naivaṁ vyasanamāpnuyāt ।। 6.83.17 ।।

translations.english: "If there is unrighteousness, Ravana should be in hell. You who are endowed with righteousness should not have agony."

verses.sloka: तस्य च व्यसनाभावाद् व्यसनं च गते त्वयि।धर्मो भवत्यधर्मश्च परस्परविरोधिनौ ।। ६.८३.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya ca vyasanābhāvād vyasanaṁ ca gate tvayi।dharmo bhavatyadharmaśca parasparavirodhinau ।। 6.83.18 ।।

translations.english: " As Ravana has no sorrow and you have experienced agony the contraries of each other have changed the roles of righteousness and unrighteousness."
translations.hindi: मकराक्ष के रथ में जो घोड़े जुते हुए थे, उनके शरीर में बल न रहा। वे लड़खडाती हुई चाल से दीन हो, आँसू टपकाते हुए चलने लगे

verses.sloka: धर्मेणोपलभेद्धर्ममधर्मं चाप्यधर्मतः।यद्यधर्मेण युज्येयुर्येष्वधर्मः प्रतिष्ठितः ।। ६.८३.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: dharmeṇopalabheddharmamadharmaṁ cāpyadharmataḥ।yadyadharmeṇa yujyeyuryeṣvadharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।। 6.83.19 ।।

translations.english: "The righteous attains the benefit through righteous means, and the unrighteous suffer by unrighteous means. If unrighteousness is rooted in the unrighteous and are pleased with unrighteousness they will be deprived of the result of righteousness. It is not otherwise."

verses.sloka: यदि धर्मेण युज्येरन्नाधर्मरुचयो जनाः।धर्मेण चरतां धर्मस्तथा चैषां फलं भवेत् ।। ६.८३.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: yadi dharmeṇa yujyerannādharmarucayo janāḥ।dharmeṇa caratāṁ dharmastathā caiṣāṁ phalaṁ bhavet ।। 6.83.20 ।।

translations.english: "The righteous attains the benefit through righteous means, and the unrighteous suffer by unrighteous means. If unrighteousness is rooted in the unrighteous and are pleased with unrighteousness they will be deprived of the result of righteousness. It is not otherwise."
translations.hindi: इन असरुनों को देखकर भी, वे बलवान समस्त राक्षस इनकी ओर ध्यान न देते हुए, चलते चलते वहाँ जा पहुँचे, जहां श्रीरामचन्द्र जी और लक्ष्मण जी थे

verses.sloka: यस्मादर्था विवर्धन्ते येष्वधर्मः पतिष्ठितः।क्लिश्यन्ते धर्मशीलाश्च तस्मादेतौ निरर्थकौ ।। ६.८३.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: yasmādarthā vivardhante yeṣvadharmaḥ patiṣṭhitaḥ।kliśyante dharmaśīlāśca tasmādetau nirarthakau ।। 6.83.21 ।।

translations.english: "Since those rooted in unrighteous develop and are wealthy, and those who follow dharma suffer both these are meaningless."

verses.sloka: वध्यन्ते पापकर्माणो यद्यधर्मेण राघव।वधकर्म हतो ऽधर्मः स हतः कं वधिष्यति ।। ६.८३.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: vadhyante pāpakarmāṇo yadyadharmeṇa rāghava।vadhakarma hato 'dharmaḥ sa hataḥ kaṁ vadhiṣyati ।। 6.83.22 ।।

translations.english: "Righteousness and unrighteousness are forms of actions, sinful or not sinful. If sinful action is unrighteous, those who have done sinful actions should suffer. Since sinful action is momentary, and as soon as the action is over unrighteousness is also gone. That being so how can unrighteousness cause pain to anyone?"

verses.sloka: अथवा विहितेनायं हन्यते हन्ति वा परम्।विधिरालिप्यते तेन न स पापेन कर्मणा ।। ६.८३.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: athavā vihitenāyaṁ hanyate hanti vā param।vidhirālipyate tena na sa pāpena karmaṇā ।। 6.83.23 ।।

translations.english: "Or else if a man is destroyed by killing another, destiny which is engendered by the sinful action suffers and not the doer of sinful action."

verses.sloka: अदृष्टप्रतिकारेण त्वव्यक्तेनासता सता।कथं शक्यं परं प्राप्तुं धर्मेणारिविकर्शन ।। ६.८३.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭapratikāreṇa tvavyaktenāsatā satā।kathaṁ śakyaṁ paraṁ prāptuṁ dharmeṇārivikarśana ।। 6.83.24 ।।

translations.english: "O Crusher of enemies! How does righteousness get encountered? It is not seen. How to know whether it is real or unreal? Is it possible to know that the best result is attained by righteousness."

verses.sloka: यदि सत् स्यात् सतां मुख्य नासत् स्यात्तव किञ्चन।त्वया यदीदृशं प्राप्तं तस्मात् सन्नोपपद्यते ।। ६.८३.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: yadi sat syāt satāṁ mukhya nāsat syāttava kiñcana।tvayā yadīdṛśaṁ prāptaṁ tasmāt sannopapadyate ।। 6.83.25 ।।

translations.english: "O foremost among the victorious! To you, who are a jewel no evil should accrue. Since such difficulty has been faced by you, the fact that good actions result in good destiny is not true."

verses.sloka: अथवा दुर्बलः क्लीबो बलं धर्मो ऽनुवर्तते।दुर्बलो हृतमर्यादो न सेव्य इति मे मतिः ।। ६.८३.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: athavā durbalaḥ klībo balaṁ dharmo 'nuvartate।durbalo hṛtamaryādo na sevya iti me matiḥ ।। 6.83.26 ।।

translations.english: "Or else dharma becomes feeble, ineffective, submits to might, then it is better not to follow such dharma which is feeble, I think."

verses.sloka: बलस्य यदि चेद्धर्मो गुणभूतः पराक्रमे।धर्ममुत्सृज्य वर्तस्व यथा धर्मे तथा बले ।। ६.८३.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: balasya yadi ceddharmo guṇabhūtaḥ parākrame।dharmamutsṛjya vartasva yathā dharme tathā bale ।। 6.83.27 ।।

translations.english: "Giving up predominance of virtue, seek courage and submit to might for succeeding in action. Seek might just as you have sought dharma earlier for success."

verses.sloka: अथ चेत् सत्यवचनं धर्मः किल परन्तप।अनृतस्त्वय्यकरुणः किं न बद्धस्त्वया पिता ।। ६.८३.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: atha cet satyavacanaṁ dharmaḥ kila parantapa।anṛtastvayyakaruṇaḥ kiṁ na baddhastvayā pitā ।। 6.83.28 ।।

translations.english: "O scorcher of enemies! If you consider speaking the truth is dharma, why did you not bind your father (who promised to give the kingdom) and was not compassionate (spoke untruth later)."

verses.sloka: यदि धर्मो भवेद्भूतो अधर्मो वा परन्तप।न स्म हत्वा मुनिं वज्री कुर्यादिज्यां शतक्रतुः ।। ६.८३.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: yadi dharmo bhavedbhūto adharmo vā parantapa।na sma hatvā muniṁ vajrī kuryādijyāṁ śatakratuḥ ।। 6.83.29 ।।

translations.english: "Indra killed an ascetic (Viswarupa) and did fire sacrifice. If dharma alone is his duty, he could have done hundreds of fire sacrifices and not have killed the ascetic. If adharma is duty he would have killed the ascetic and not done fire sacrifice."
translations.hindi: इति श्रष्टसप्ततितमः सगँ: उन राक्षसों के शरीर का रंग मेघों, गर्जो और भैसों के शरीर के रंग की तरह काला था । उनके शरीरों पर गदा, तलवार तथा ८७० युद्धकाण्डे अन्य असरों के घावों की गूतें थीं। वे सब के सब युद्धविद्या में चतुर थे । “पहिले में लड़ गा, पहिले में लड़ गा” कह कह कर, सिंझनाद करते हुए वे ( समरभूमि में ) चारों ओर घूमने लगे

verses.sloka: अधर्मसंश्रितो धर्मो विनाशयति राघव।सर्वमेतद्यथाकामं काकुत्स्थ कुरुते नरः ।। ६.८३.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: adharmasaṁśrito dharmo vināśayati rāghava।sarvametadyathākāmaṁ kākutstha kurute naraḥ ।। 6.83.30 ।।

translations.english: "Kakuthsa Rama! Kings followed dharma and adharma both according to context. Whether following dharma or adharma destruction is happening. Therefore, humans keep doing both as per their desire."

verses.sloka: मम चेदं मतं तात धर्मो ऽयमिति राघव।धर्ममूलं त्वया छिन्नं राज्यमुत्सृजता तदा ।। ६.८३.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: mama cedaṁ mataṁ tāta dharmo 'yamiti rāghava।dharmamūlaṁ tvayā chinnaṁ rājyamutsṛjatā tadā ।। 6.83.31 ।।

translations.english: "Dear Raghava! In my opinion also depending on desire and context, following dharma or adharma is proper. You have severed the roots of dharma by giving up the kingdom."

verses.sloka: अर्थेभ्यो हि विवृद्धेभ्यः संवृत्तेभ्यस्ततस्ततः।क्रियाः सर्वाः प्रवर्तन्ते पर्वतेभ्य इवापगाः ।। ६.८३.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: arthebhyo hi vivṛddhebhyaḥ saṁvṛttebhyastatastataḥ।kriyāḥ sarvāḥ pravartante parvatebhya ivāpagāḥ ।। 6.83.32 ।।

translations.english: "Prosperity is augmented gradually and developed by all means just as rivers flow from mountains, all undertakings follow conducive to success."

verses.sloka: अर्थेन हि वियुक्तस्य पुरुषस्याल्पतेजसः।व्युच्छिद्यन्ते क्रियाः सर्वा ग्रीष्मे कुसरितो यथा ।। ६.८३.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: arthena hi viyuktasya puruṣasyālpatejasaḥ।vyucchidyante kriyāḥ sarvā grīṣme kusarito yathā ।। 6.83.33 ।।

translations.english: "Just like streams dry up in summer, if one who is of meagre intelligence and forsakes wealth, all his actions will be interrupted."

verses.sloka: सो ऽयमर्थं परित्यज्य सुखकामः सुखैधितः।पापमारभते कर्तुं ततो दोषः प्रवर्तते ।। ६.८३.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: so 'yamarthaṁ parityajya sukhakāmaḥ sukhaidhitaḥ।pāpamārabhate kartuṁ tato doṣaḥ pravartate ।। 6.83.34 ।।

translations.english: "If one who has been happy seeks happiness on renouncing wealth then proceeds to perform sinful actions it is a mistake."

verses.sloka: यस्यार्थास्तस्य मित्राणि यस्यार्थास्तस्य बान्धवाः।यस्यार्थाः स पुमान् लोके यस्यार्थाः स च पण्डितः ।। ६.८३.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: yasyārthāstasya mitrāṇi yasyārthāstasya bāndhavāḥ।yasyārthāḥ sa pumān loke yasyārthāḥ sa ca paṇḍitaḥ ।। 6.83.35 ।।

translations.english: "Friends gather round him in whom riches abide. Relations stand by him who has wealth. He is considered manly in whom wealth abides, and he is learned who has wealth."

verses.sloka: यस्यार्थाः स च विक्रान्तो यस्यार्थाः स च बुद्धिमान्।यस्यार्थाः स महाभागो यस्यार्थाः स महागुणः ।। ६.८३.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: yasyārthāḥ sa ca vikrānto yasyārthāḥ sa ca buddhimān।yasyārthāḥ sa mahābhāgo yasyārthāḥ sa mahāguṇaḥ ।। 6.83.36 ।।

translations.english: He is gallant to whom wealth has flown, he is intelligent in whom wealth abides, he is glorious in whom wealth exists and he is superior in great virtues in whom wealth found receptacle.

verses.sloka: अर्थस्यैते परित्यागे दोषाः प्रव्याहृता मया।राज्यमुत्सृजता वीर येन बुद्धिस्त्वया कृता ।। ६.८३.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: arthasyaite parityāge doṣāḥ pravyāhṛtā mayā।rājyamutsṛjatā vīra yena buddhistvayā kṛtā ।। 6.83.37 ।।

translations.english: 'If you give up wealth the evils will follow you', said I. Now you left the kingdom. The basis on which you made such a resolve is not known to me.

verses.sloka: यस्यार्था धर्मकामार्थास्तस्य सर्वं प्रदक्षिणम्।अधनेनार्थकामेन नार्थः शक्यो विचिन्वता ।। ६.८३.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: yasyārthā dharmakāmārthāstasya sarvaṁ pradakṣiṇam।adhanenārthakāmena nārthaḥ śakyo vicinvatā ।। 6.83.38 ।।

translations.english: For one who has wealth all his actions of dharma would give pleasure and favourable. One who has no wealth and is worrying about it can't attain it.

verses.sloka: हर्षः कामश्च दर्पश्च धर्मः क्रोधः शमो दमः।अर्थादेतानि सर्वाणि प्रवर्तन्ते नराधिप ।। ६.८३.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: harṣaḥ kāmaśca darpaśca dharmaḥ krodhaḥ śamo damaḥ।arthādetāni sarvāṇi pravartante narādhipa ।। 6.83.39 ।।

translations.english: "O Rama! Desire, delight, pride, virtue, anger, forgiveness, fortitude all these are effective through wealth."

verses.sloka: येषां नश्यत्ययं लोकश्चरतां धर्मचारिणाम्।ते ऽर्थास्त्वयि न दृश्यन्ते दुर्दिनेषु यथा ग्रहाः ।। ६.८३.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṁ naśyatyayaṁ lokaścaratāṁ dharmacāriṇām।te 'rthāstvayi na dṛśyante durdineṣu yathā grahāḥ ।। 6.83.40 ।।

translations.english: "Even if there is wealth if one renunciates wealth and follows dharma in this world they perish like planets on cloudy days."

verses.sloka: त्वयि प्रव्रजिते वीर गुरोश्च वचने स्थिते।रक्षसा ऽपहृता भार्या प्राणैः प्रियतरा तव ।। ६.८३.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tvayi pravrajite vīra gurośca vacane sthite।rakṣasā 'pahṛtā bhāryā prāṇaiḥ priyatarā tava ।। 6.83.41 ।।

translations.english: "O heroic Rama! You have been faithful to the promise to your father and left home following dharma (giving up wealth), and your dear wife who is your life has been abducted by Rakshasa."

verses.sloka: तदद्य विपुलं वीर दुःखमिन्द्रजिता कृतम्।कर्मणा व्यपनेष्यामि तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ राघव ।। ६.८३.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadadya vipulaṁ vīra duḥkhamindrajitā kṛtam।karmaṇā vyapaneṣyāmi tasmāduttiṣṭha rāghava ।। 6.83.42 ।।

translations.english: "Get up, heroic Raghava! I will get rid of the agony caused to you by Indrajith, by the action."

verses.sloka: उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल दीर्घवाहो दृढव्रत।किमात्मानं महात्मानमात्मानं नावबुध्यसे ।। ६.८३.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: uttiṣṭha naraśārdūla dīrghavāho dṛḍhavrata।kimātmānaṁ mahātmānamātmānaṁ nāvabudhyase ।। 6.83.43 ।।

translations.english: "O tiger among men! O broad shouldered endowed with fortitude! Why do you not know yourself that you are a great soul and doer of action?"

verses.sloka: अयमनघ तवोदितः प्रियार्थं जनकसुतानिधनं निरीक्ष्य रुष्टः।सहयगजरथां सराक्षसेन्द्रां भृशमिषुभिर्विनिपातयामि लङ्काम् ।। ६.८३.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ayamanagha tavoditaḥ priyārthaṁ janakasutānidhanaṁ nirīkṣya ruṣṭaḥ।sahayagajarathāṁ sarākṣasendrāṁ bhṛśamiṣubhirvinipātayāmi laṅkām ।। 6.83.44 ।।

translations.english: 'O sinless one, all this I have said only for your pleasure. Enraged at beholding the death of Janaka's daughter, I shall lay low with my arrows this whole Lanka, with its horses, elephants and chariots, together with the lord of the rakshasas.'

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे त्र्यशीतितमः सर्गः ।। ८३ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe tryaśītitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 83 ।।
